title: Steve Was Hiding Something

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

movie_note: Movie Episode 8 (the creator's 16:9 blueprint, 2026-11-27; story/movie/ep08_shots.md): out of Ep7's cyan warp flash onto the tall grass of Steve's hidden forest clearing at golden sunset; Steve pulls the vines off his old obsidian portal; 'You had a PORTAL?!'; the flashback (past-Steve places the last block, flint and steel, the first portal flares, a glimpse of the obby); the confession; the forgiveness and the shoulder pat as the sun drops into deep blue twilight; the portal self-ignites violet (REALITY 30 -> 12), Steve: '...I didn't do that.'; a magenta crack; hard cut into ep10_part1_null_entrance. Null never seen. Original takes (movie/ep08_published); one new take (Steve's '...I didn't do that.', the published line was Patch's).

events.note: Shot 1 (28 mm wide, low, golden sunset): Ep7's white-cyan warp flash fades down onto the forest clearing: tall grass, oaks, the snowy peaks glowing faintly
Steve, the Noob and Patch tumble out of the warp onto the grass: Steve to one knee (empty-handed), the Noob rolling onto his back (no hammer), Patch wobbling then steadying
Steve gets up first, looks round, knows where he is
he walks quickly to a vine-choked archway under an oak at the clearing's edge
he pulls two hanging vine/moss clusters clear by hand: the ancient unlit obsidian frame
the Noob scrambles up behind him

events.name: noob_portal
events.note: the original take; genuinely shocked, wide eyes, lip-sync
Steve's hand still on the vines; he doesn't answer
Shot 2 (35 mm medium): a smooth desaturating dissolve into the memory, cool hazy twilight blue (no white flash, no Patch laser)
past-Steve sets the last obsidian block into the frame
he strikes flint and steel: sparks
the portal flares open: for a split second colourful obby blocks shimmer through the violet haze, then dark purple static ripples round the edges; Steve steps back in quiet awe

events.name: steve_first
events.text: I built the first one. Before I met you.
events.direction_text: [quiet, guilty, not looking at him] I built the first one. Before I met you.
events.note: the original take, as voice-over over the memory

events.name: patch_started
events.note: the original take, voice-over, quiet
past-Steve watching the portal he made
the memory dissolves back to the clearing at sunset
Shot 3A (50 mm MCU on the Noob, sunset rim): his brows pinch in real hurt, his shoulders drop; no smile, no hammer

events.name: noob_fault
events.text: So all of this... is YOUR fault?
events.direction_text: [hurt, quiet then rising] So all of this... is YOUR fault?
events.note: the original take; full lip-sync, hurt
Shot 3B (65 mm close-up on Steve, shallow focus, the peaks going indigo behind him): his head down -12 degrees, a slow blink, an exhale

events.name: steve_cost
events.text: I wanted to see the other side. Your side. I didn't know what it would cost.
events.direction_text: [quiet, honest, heavy] I wanted to see the other side. I didn't know what it would cost.
events.solo_text: I wanted to see the other side. Your side. I didn't know what it would cost.
events.note: the original take; a 3-frame blink right before 'Your side', his eyes rising to the Noob's on it, dipping again on '...what it would cost'
the sunset deepening; neither speaks
Shot 4A (50 mm close-up on the Noob): his worried brow relaxes

events.name: noob_blocks
events.text: ...I touch weird blocks all the time.
events.direction_text: [small, sheepish, forgiving] ...I touch weird blocks all the time.
events.note: the original take; a warm crooked smile, a slight playful head tilt, lip-sync
Steve almost smiles
Shot 4B (35 mm warm two-shot in front of the unlit portal, the light now deep blue twilight): the Noob steps beside Steve
a gentle shoulder pat: the Noob's right elbow bent, his hand resting on Steve's left sleeve for 10 frames, dropping to his side

events.name: steve_same
events.direction_text: [dry, a small smile] That's not the same.
events.note: the original take; a tiny reluctant half-smile

events.name: noob_kinda
events.note: the original take; he grins back
the two side by side in the twilight; the piano's last phrase
a breath of stillness

Shot 5A (40 mm two-shot): a deep violet glow sweeps across their faces from behind the camera (no white blowout, nobody vanishes); the piano and crickets cut dead under the THOOM; they freeze, then turn their heads slowly toward the portal; REALITY fractures 30 -> 12
Shot 5B (32 mm, a slow creeping push-in on the freestanding portal, dark trees and snowy peaks behind): the frame blazes with the finale's deep violet plasma, purple light across the tall grass

events.name: steve_didnt
events.direction_text: [a breathless whisper close to the mic, quiet dread] ...I didn't do that.
